ggcalor: Heatmaps as a Grammar of Cells for 'ggplot2'

Source: R/ggcalor-package.R
ggcalor-package.Rd

A 'ggplot2'-native grammar for heatmaps and other cell grids. Cells are square by default and sized in absolute units, so the plot sizes itself instead of the device. Rows and columns can be scaled, ordered, clustered and decorated with dendrograms, and the result stays an ordinary 'ggplot' object that accepts themes, scales and labels. 'calor' is Spanish for heat.
